preflight.limitations: Six bounded actual searches; no exhaustive novelty or retraction audit. Publisher full text readable despite cookie redirect. No supplementary raw data inspected. Prior work already supports the single-event covariance rule; no novelty claim.

preflight.baseline: Closed-form ballistic impact map and direct derivative, compared with flow-composed saltation vs reset-Jacobian-only covariance.
